structure_policy_rationale: Original 图标本身已经是高度概括的图形符号（鹦鹉+麦克风），并非写实照片。根据 theme_rules，对于清晰的几何符号或物体轮廓，应保留其主体拓扑结构。因此，必须维持‘左侧鹦鹉头+右下麦克风’的空间布局，仅对边缘和填充进行主题化重构，而非重新设计场景。
preserve: parrot head side profile silhouette facing right
distinctive ear/crest tuft at top-left of the head
microphone shape positioned in the lower-right quadrant
must_preserve: relative spatial layout: parrot head on left/center, microphone bottom-right
thick, rough, hand-drawn black outline around the main subject
recognition of the 'singing bird' concept through shape alone
recompose_allowed: replace original orange-to-pink gradient with solid blocks of brick red, creamy yellow, or deep blue
simplify the eye into a simple geometric void or solid color block (white/yellow)
abstract the microphone into a simple rounded rectangle or circle with a short handle
convert smooth vector edges into jittery, uneven marker-like strokes
restyle: use flat, matte color fills without gradients or shadows
simulate crayon or thick marker texture on edges and fills
forbid: realistic textures, lighting, shadows, or 3D effects
thin, clean, or perfect vector lines
colors outside the theme palette (no green, cyan, purple, or neon)
changing the orientation of the bird or position of the microphone
generation_brief: Retro hand-drawn doodle icon on pure black background. Simplified parrot head silhouette facing right with a crest, holding a microphone at bottom-right. Thick, rough black outlines. Filled with solid blocks of brick red, creamy yellow, and deep blue. No gradients, no shadows, flat naive art style.
color_application: Map original brand colors to theme palette: use brick red for the main body/head, creamy yellow for highlights/beak/eye area, and deep blue for the microphone or accents. Strictly no gradients; use solid flat colors only.
stroke_application: Apply a thick, irregular, hand-drawn black stroke around the entire composite shape (bird + mic). The stroke should look like it was drawn with a dry marker, with varying thickness and rough edges.
composition_application: Center the combined bird-mic glyph. Ensure it occupies 60-70% of the canvas. Maintain the specific spatial relationship: bird head dominant, microphone tucked in lower right. Keep background purely black and empty.
identity_application: Preserve the iconic side-profile silhouette of the parrot and the presence of the microphone. Simplify internal details (like the eye) to geometric shapes but keep the overall topology recognizable as the Karaoke app logo.
fidelity_constraints: Must have thick, rough hand-drawn black outlines
Colors must be limited to brick red, deep blue, creamy yellow/white
No gradients, shadows, or 3D effects allowed
Subject must be flat, simplified geometric blocks
negative_constraints: No thin or perfect vector lines
No extra decorative elements or text
No change in bird orientation or mic position
